# `foxglove extensions publish`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](extensions.md)

```text
Publish a Studio extension (.foxe) to your organization

Usage: foxglove extensions publish [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>


Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
